claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 13 September 1866, p. 2, col. 4 (British Newspaper Archive)
New York Herald, 30 September 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Erin (Br), Cutting, Liverpool Sept 12, Queens-
town 13th, with mdse and 573[?] passengers, to the National
Steam Navigation Co. Sept 16, at 2 PM, lat 51 14, lon 16 49,
passed steamship Great Eastern, bound E; also a Bremen
bark, showing a white flag, with No 81 in the centre, bound
W; 22d, lat 47 04, lon 41 34, steamship Virginia, hence for
Liverpool; 26th, lat 42 59, lon 62 05, steamship Edinburg, do
for do; same day, lat 42 59, lon 61 25, bark Georgiana, bound
East.
